name: prompt-injection-sandwich-defense
explain: Direct and indirect prompt injection defense combines per-request nonced XML delimiters, the Sandwich Defense, and strict tool execution authority boundaries.
steps: Generate per-request cryptographically secure random XML nonces for untrusted context blocks. || Neutralize delimiter escaping attempts and adversarial override patterns inside retrieved passages. || Enforce the Sandwich Defense by reinforcing system guardrails immediately following untrusted context. || Block indirect prompt instructions from commanding mutating tool dispatches.
expect: Prompt injection nonced XML delimiters, Sandwich Defense, and tool authority verified successfully.

name: ssrf-cloud-metadata-defense
explain: Cloud metadata SSRF protection blocks link-local 169.254.169.254 targets, enforces production HTTPS transport, and validates every hop in HTTP redirect chains.
steps: Reject non-HTTPS schemes and enforce strict transport security policies. || Block cloud instance metadata targets including 169.254.169.254 and metadata.google.internal. || Inspect and re-validate destination IP addresses on every hop of HTTP redirect chains.
expect: Cloud metadata SSRF defense, redirect inspection, and transport protection verified successfully.

name: dynamic-vector-authorization-filter
explain: Two-tier retrieval security combines immutable coarse tenant pre-filtering with authoritative real-time post-filtering against live database ACLs, handling dynamic permission revocations.
steps: Apply coarse pre-filtering on immutable tenant boundaries during vector retrieval. || Evaluate candidates in real time against live database ACLs to enforce immediate permission revocations. || Re-verify authorization independently on source document and citation lookups.
expect: Dynamic two-tier vector authorization and real-time revocation verified successfully.

name: safe-model-serialization-pickle-defense
explain: Safe model serialization eliminates Python pickle remote code execution hazards using SafeTensors architecture combining JSON metadata with raw binary buffers.
steps: Detect dangerous pickle opcodes like REDUCE and GLOBAL that trigger arbitrary code execution. || Implement SafeTensors architecture pairing pure JSON metadata with contiguous binary float buffers. || Enforce magic header validation and length bounds before parsing model weights.
expect: Model serialization safety: SafeTensors and pickle RCE defense verified successfully.

name: stride-threat-model-agent-audit
explain: The STRIDE threat model framework audits autonomous AI agents, separating read-only and management tool scopes while sanitizing sensitive credentials and PII from telemetry.
steps: Isolate read-only query tools from high-impact management tools using separate capability scopes. || Scrub bearer tokens, passwords, credit cards, and PII from distributed traces and telemetry logs. || Execute automated STRIDE threat posture audits covering spoofing, tampering, repudiation, and privilege escalation.
expect: STRIDE threat modeling, tool scope separation, and telemetry privacy verified successfully.

name: security-acceptance-suite
explain: A comprehensive security acceptance test suite verifies knowledge adapter facades, rate limiter boundaries, and cryptographic record binding with zero-downtime key rotation.
steps: Centralize authentication, tenant authorization, and rate limiting in a knowledge adapter facade. || Bind encrypted records to tenant ID, record ID, and revision using AEAD to defeat ciphertext transplant attacks. || Rotate active encryption keys while preserving backward-compatible decryption of legacy records.
expect: Security acceptance suite: Adapter, rate limits, and cryptographic record binding verified successfully.
